annotation.title_clean: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/851 correcting the Portuguese language version of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/851 correcting the Portuguese language version of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Delegated Regulation correcting translation errors in the Portuguese version of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and third-country UAS operators. It has no substantive effect on English text and applies retroactively from 9 August 2020 for legal certainty.
key_provisions_or_claims: Corrects Portuguese version of Regulation 2019/945 (Art. 17(4), Art. 40(1)(d), Annex Part 8 Module B)
Applies from 9 August 2020 for legal certainty and level playing field
Enters into force twentieth day after publication; directly applicable
